name: Secured Finance same-block order-book unit price valued as collateral
summary: Secured Finance valued lend positions used as collateral with LendingMarket.getMarketUnitPrice, which returns the current block's filled amount divided by filled future value once block volume passes a fixed threshold. Attackers matched orders between two of their own accounts inside one transaction to set that price, so a cheaply bought lend position counted as fully backed collateral, and withdrew other depositors' USDC, WBTC, WETH and JPYC from the TokenVault on Ethereum and Arbitrum.

loss.notes: Exact net TokenVault outflow across nine successful Ethereum drains by four actors (blocks 25914035-25914841) and three Arbitrum drains by the anchor attacker (blocks 502170775-502171688), all exploiting the same order-book price in the same compiled LendingMarket template. Attacker and helper deposits made inside each transaction are netted out. Stablecoins at par; WBTC, WETH and JPYC at DefiLlama prices contemporaneous with each asset's largest drain. The DeFiHackLabs headline (~$104K) omits part of this campaign; the measured total is higher.

ageReset.description: Ninth and last pre-exploit Upgraded event of the LendingMarket beacon read by the market proxy, selecting implementation 0xd06dd40ba7c2cff3a6aa2f59c55d249aca57e521 with newly linked OrderActionLogic 0x41eb72013fd9b65fb9b9bbfa36894ca3a630750b; beacon.implementation() still returns it at block 25914034.

sources.note: Reviewed anchor, root cause and first exercise. eth_getTransactionReceipt and debug_traceTransaction(callTracer) of source-1 (Ethereum block 25914035, index 375, status 1, timestamp 1788646283): EOA 0xfc3facd67138966ab0c841e905b0c4bca1abe92f calls selector 0x61461954 on its contract 0xb149182cc2c023d16683a4b9bdada24d9ffa25cb, created at index 374 by 0x2b4373e480188b410e430b47efd98c721c5e9be9f3e2764bd4536bdd53b59d6d. The contract and a second attacker account 0x0e1b9808f5fdc33a9b78bba566c1f38367e08d74 make 27 LendingMarketController (LMC proxy 0x35e9d8e0223a75e51a67aa731127c91ea0779fe2) executeOrder(bytes32,uint256,uint8,uint256,uint256) calls (selector 0xf43947c7, 26 by the contract, 1 by the helper, currency USDC), 9 cancelOrder (0x49f2ccbf) and 2 cleanUpFunds (0x9519832b), TokenVault (0xb74749b2213916b1da3b869e41c7c57f1db69393) deposits of 3100 and 1 USDC by the contract and 3000 USDC by the helper, and 3 withdraw (0x040cf020) calls paying the contract 3099.999998, 3000 and 3001.000004 USDC. Each order routes through the USDC LendingMarket beacon proxy 0x75c762781bcc7dce2fd1512099b71ca8b3634b1f to implementation 0xd06dd40ba7c2cff3a6aa2f59c55d249aca57e521 and its linked libraries OrderActionLogic 0x41eb72013fd9b65fb9b9bbfa36894ca3a630750b (selectors 0xf506ad30, 0x447265be, 0xf3f7f452) and OrderBookLogic 0x05e71dc39c3de40e017d166e605b97451e7f21b5; the withdrawal collateral checks run FundManagementLogic 0x4beabc7e235dd893dfb44216ef9a68e66272a3c8 in the LMC context, which calls getMarketUnitPrice(uint8) (0x2bfa7c13) on the market proxy: 63 DELEGATECALL frames from 0x75c7... into 0x05e71d... with that selector. Root cause from verified source (source-5): OrderBookLib.getMarketUnitPrice(self, true) (reached via OrderBookLogic.getMarketUnitPrice) returns blockTotalAmount*10000/blockTotalFutureValue of the CURRENT block whenever isReliableBlock is set, and OrderBookLib.updateBlockUnitPriceHistory (inlined in OrderActionLogic) sums every fill of the block into those totals and sets isReliableBlock once blockTotalAmount >= the implementation immutable minimum (minimumReliableAmountInBaseCurrency() = 10000000000 via eth_call on 0x75c7... at block 25914034). FundManagementLogic._calculatePVFromFV values future-value positions with that price, so orders the attacker matches between its own two accounts inside one transaction set the price that marks its cheaply bought lend position as fully backed collateral, and TokenVault.withdraw releases other depositors' USDC against it. All calls are permissionless; no privileged role acts. First-exercise scan: Etherscan V2 account.tokentx for the TokenVault, blocks 0..25880000 (656 transfers, 652 transactions) and 25880000..26060000 (49 transfers), plus account.txlistinternal (580 native transfers). Transactions in which the vault both receives from and pays external accounts are only the three equal-amount JPYC round trips of 0xafc8cf94f8e43e874a1f9a3e19b112305f38c4a7 (blocks 24244363, 24267104, 25152539) and the nine campaign transactions of source-9, source-1 first. All 69 vault-outflow transactions since beacon activation block 24425782 were classified by top-level recipient: 47 direct TokenVault calls, 13 Yearn V3 vault 0x7a6e3635694952dc00f6ba4d4ad1a7b892028789 / strategy 0x6f6046e59501e484152d46045ba5eecf1cab8935 / 0xafc8cf94... transactions each with at most one executeOrder call (callTracer), i.e. ordinary strategy unwinds, and the nine campaign transactions. Pre-anchor transactions of 0xfc3facd6... from block 25900000 (0x36f2f478dcb34a00068f9d609e9b38bf9aaedbd69f491eb0828d6756548fe2dd, 0x4e6f5a6427b5afdeaaa31245d6ef19e098e387944be60090063eb5dd6b00c283) never call the LMC or vault. The DeFiHackLabs reference (source-2) models the later c0ffeebabe WBTC drain 0xcd6159860783d8d481cc4bf4dceddc88acdca6bb08f6445525b2904cfd75b1da (block 25914192, 157 blocks after source-1) and mentions a reverted attempt; a reverted transaction is not an exercise. Merged campaign (same fault, same beacon implementation on Ethereum): source-9 lists the nine successful drains by 0xfc3facd6... (USDC 25914035, WETH 25914571 and 25914652, WBTC 25914679), 0xc0ffeebabe5d496b2dde509f9fa189c25cf29671 via 0xe08d97e151473a848c3d9ca3f323cb720472d015 (WBTC 25914192, WETH 25914488), 0xf601d7646c2db4940f0b1909b4835ed7279c5aed via 0x9cb7a294cd1b0df5a1d335e713aa0c7f8f8dd5f1 (USDC 25914405) and 0xefb0eb625f472453d4750e4bc57ed7c5c4cd59d3 via constructor-executed contracts (JPYC 25914552 and 25914841). Each trace shows 23-27 executeOrder calls on one currency and 2-4 vault withdrawals; eight use two attacker accounts, 0xcf85f506... uses one. Market proxies executed: USDC 0x75c7..., WBTC 0x2dcb346fd48e5ea28bb6812df0a8d4c2cd006feb, ETH 0x6b613d2db118c99fc8cfb408ef54824c7e39ed44, JPYC 0xc4dbd1702a0a12c6c1e58a76cfd8b044ffb0a275, all delegating to 0xd06dd40b.... Same-campaign Arbitrum leg (source-10): 0xfc3facd6... repeated the attack on the Arbitrum deployment at the same proxy addresses (blocks 502170775, 502171020, 502171688). There the beacon 0x62012fa259ac86894078223a3789de6dd74c50c7 points to 0x99db823112d281aac07b6f2f3b978ea2dc27cd69, whose runtime equals 0xd06dd40b... after mapping its four linked-library addresses (0x05e71d->0xd0fedbe5, 0x41eb72->0x6bb750f0, 0x21ee63->0xf5ce343c, 0x14185d5c unchanged; 0 residual bytes, identical CBOR metadata). No September 2026 vault outflow on Avalanche (tokentx chainid 43114; last outflow 2026-07-10). The four campaign EOAs have nonce 0 on Filecoin (api.node.glif.io).

Reviewed artifact identity and age history. Execution context: USDC LendingMarket 0x75c762781bcc7dce2fd1512099b71ca8b3634b1f, an UpgradeabilityBeaconProxy (verified OpenZeppelin BeaconProxy) whose EIP-1967 beacon slot 0xa3f0ad74...3d50 holds 0x62012fa259ac86894078223a3789de6dd74c50c7 at block 25914034; its implementation slot 0x360894a1... is 0 and BeaconProxy._implementation() reads beacon.implementation(), which returns 0xd06dd40ba7c2cff3a6aa2f59c55d249aca57e521 at block 25914034. The proxy's only BeaconUpgraded log (topic 0x1cf3b03a...) is its creation log in source-6 (block 18780923, index 63, log 153) selecting the same beacon; it has no Upgraded log. callTracer of source-6 shows CREATE of 0x75c7... by BeaconProxyController 0x581e463841bd2b30285929448e1a93d74708719f, called through LMC by 0x4f122d7fce7971e38801af5d96fcd4ed83efd654; eth_getCode at block 18780922 is empty. Code artifact 0xd06dd40b... (verified LendingMarket, solc v0.8.19+commit.7dd6d404; Etherscan V2 contract.getsourcecode SourceCode SHA-256 9c4fb71f41638a54fe754bcbe6ee5f73fba4b37e34bc366f40a54ff76b5df5af) was created by 0x4f122d7f... in source-8 (block 24423177, index 70); eth_getCode is empty at block 24423176 and keccak256 is 0x8e522bfa0342951c5d6a116683c2c1bd0b13b76554e1a54dbb20773fe92f8e1d at blocks 24423177, 24425782 and 25914034. Its runtime hard-links OrderBookLogic 0x05e71dc39c3de40e017d166e605b97451e7f21b5 (getMarketUnitPrice; source SHA-256 fa0289e662e6b281dceffacafae6c7bd75674ceba8486bcecaa8b29ae5a62ca2), OrderActionLogic 0x41eb72013fd9b65fb9b9bbfa36894ca3a630750b (updateBlockUnitPriceHistory; SHA-256 158c3c4805676cf1d6f63de1ee0337a41466e37480f063c1e02c16e1292e9535, created block 24423176), OrderReaderLogic 0x21ee63365fdd27fb4f092eee684992935f91b33d and 0x14185d5cd8589b194e881b9bdd081c185d5cd959 (PUSH20 scan), and embeds MINIMUM_RELIABLE_AMOUNT_IN_BASE_CURRENCY as an immutable, so the implementation address fixes the whole defect-bearing code set and the reliability threshold. Beacon history: Etherscan getLogs Upgraded(address) topic 0xbc7cd75a... on 0x62012fa2..., blocks 0..latest, returns 10 logs: 19135149, 19529722, 19957955, 22686163, 22780464, 22943479, 23346123, 23995145 (0x08cdef1c1a311ff6a4a4fb27cdc33b77866c51cd, which links the same OrderBookLogic but OrderActionLogic 0xc1decd6c26cf2fc6001e3d3afa3fcd7f4e47bee3), 24425782 (source-7, index 425, log 649, topic1 0xd06dd40b...), and the post-exploit fix 26050390 (0xf2981cb949b4210f1eebee271876ba623354ad57). Source-7 is the latest pre-exploit change of the executed market code; in the same transaction LMC log 641 (implementation 0xd0ae7b08cefee9eda4f8635ebe87ab6f8cf0214c) and TokenVault log 645 (0x4675b1573c528c4d5b4fe60e647810e4cf3135d4) precede it. The only later pre-exploit upgrade on the execution path is LMC 0x39c18bebadf2da4f79c3f09383a29d724bed4f19848caa72d15bd8e1c1a04407 (block 25148695, log 90) to 0x60ccbf7e864df8c7223216baca4149a8190e5fc7: both 23684-byte runtimes are identical after replacing the four PUSH20 occurrences of LiquidationLogic 0x0e19131fe07758fbd658fe51951b4ddabcaa2b34 with 0xf90ef8acb9aa90c67ecb3c844e35af8b5b405093, except the 32-byte CBOR metadata hash; both link the same consumer libraries FundManagementLogic 0x4beabc7e..., LendingMarketUserLogic 0x37808387929c4ca07cd01929aeb142e2ddb32efc and LendingMarketOperationLogic 0x3a2a5ac34cbba8db4efe8a9a5c13efc57171fb8b; LiquidationLogic is never delegatecalled in source-1. That upgrade changed no executed code, so it is not an age reset. No configuration value is necessary to the flaw: the threshold is an implementation immutable and order-book openings only provide exposure. The knot therefore is beacon log 649: codeAgeSeconds = 1788646283 - 1770719375 = 17926908.
